svg.aria-label: Aerodrome 810 ft below sea level with QFE 1035 hPa. A warmer-than-ISA column gives less than 30 hPa change and QFF above QNH 1005; an ISA column gives 30 hPa change and QFF equal to QNH 1005; a colder-than-ISA column gives more than 30 hPa change and QFF below QNH 1005.
